name: Alina Chajkina
source: At some point becoming friends with Anton after Sasha had befriended him, (despite knowing Anton for 9 years prior through school), she ended up just fitting in with their friend group. She's the class president of their homeroom, and does well in school. She's a fan of k-pop and gacha games.
